title: Transportation Engineering Safety Related Projects 2024
description:
Fremont’s roadway infrastructure continues to evolve to enhance safety and accessibility for all residents.  The City’s General Plan and Mobility Action Plan aims to increase walking and biking while reducing crashes involving vulnerable roadway users.  The City is committed to educating all roadway users on safely navigating these new infrastructure treatments, ensuring they can remain confident and secure while driving, biking, or walking.

The recent changes in Fremont’s roadways include the addition of roundabouts, protected intersections, protected bike lanes, street markings, and updated traffic signal systems.  These improvements are designed to reduce severe injury/fatal crashes and reduce vehicle speeds while optimizing vehicle traffic flow.  Learn more about the various roadway improvements and transportation projects below.
